title: Money: Naira Coins and Notes
seo_title: Money – Primary 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Recognise Nigerian coins and notes up to ₦100; count small amounts of money; buy and give change. (summary of the NERDC Primary 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 1 maths worksheets on Nigerian money with pictures: naira coins and notes up to ₦100, which is worth more, counting money and simple shopping. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Nigerian money is called naira (₦).
  • We have coins (₦1 and ₦2) and notes (₦5, ₦10, ₦20, ₦50, ₦100).
  • To count money, start with the biggest and count on.

Examples

Example

₦50 + ₦20 + ₦5

Count on

Answer: ₦75

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting how many notesCount what each note is worth.
Thinking a big note means a big numberRead the number on it.
Adding when finding changeChange: take away.
